svg.title: The eight-query verification shape caused an XPU attention cliff
svg.desc: At 262,144 cached tokens, one query row took 0.505 milliseconds, one eight-query call took 23.362 milliseconds, eight serial one-query calls took 3.900 milliseconds, and a batch of eight one-query rows took 2.090 milliseconds. All measurements used the same 268 megabyte KV scan per row.
svg.title: The eight-query verification shape caused an XPU attention cliff
